Retain the original edge quotient stack with weights+1/-1, its two DVR charts and semistable closed-fibre interpretation

difficulty_reason: H2: the new own core is a finite sequence of elementary transformations chosen from relative DVR-lattice exponents that preserves semistability at every stage. Translating each edge into the two-chart quotient stack and combining good-moduli universality with DVR lifting/descent proves uniqueness for the concrete moduli problem. This is a nonroutine sheaf/stack construction and descent argument beyond merely applying the generic valuative criterion. The H3 existence construction is explicitly reused from1922 and is not counted again; the full new Langton/DVR/final proof842-1009 is supplied.
